findings.title: Hosted repository protections required by the release policy are disabled
findings.impact: A direct or compromised-author push can change main without required checks or independent review, and hosted secret/dependency protections will not prevent or report several credential and vulnerable-component conditions.
findings.exploitPath: An identity with write access pushes or merges unreviewed code directly to unprotected main; disabled hosted protections do not require validation or block detected credentials before source becomes the package basis.
evidence: Main branch protection returned HTTP 404 Branch not protected and repository rulesets returned none.
Secret scanning, push protection, non-provider patterns, validity checks, and Dependabot security updates are disabled.
Dependabot alerts are disabled, private vulnerability reporting is false, and the code-scanning alerts endpoint reports no analysis because CodeQL upload is configured as never.
Actions permit all actions, although default workflow token permissions are read-only and current workflow dependencies are commit-pinned.
findings.resolution: Configure hosted branch/ruleset enforcement for required Security Validation and CodeQL checks and independent review; enable secret scanning, push protection, dependency alerts/security updates, private vulnerability reporting, and uploaded CodeQL results where supported.
references: GitHub REST read-only repository evidence collected 2026-09-05
